meta.name: scientific-writing
meta.description: Draft and revise scientific manuscript sections with claim-evidence alignment and reproducible method reporting.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 起草和修改科学论文的各个章节
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要撰写或润色科研论文
copy.tagline_en: Draft and revise sections of scientific manuscripts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write or polish research papers

howto.what: Claude 会帮你起草和修改科学论文的各个部分，确保每个论点都有实验证据支持，方法描述可重复，并明确列出局限性和下一步实验。
howto.when: 当你要求更新稿件、撰写方法/结果/讨论部分、或让语言更严谨时触发。

say.text: 帮我写这段实验方法的初稿。
say.note: Claude 会从仓库代码和日志中提取细节。

say.text: 检查结果部分，确保每个结论都有证据对应。
say.note: Claude 会核对论点与证据的匹配。

howto.what_en: Claude helps draft and revise scientific manuscript sections, ensuring claims are backed by evidence, methods are reproducible, and limitations and next steps are explicitly stated.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to update the manuscript, write methods/results/discussion, or tighten scientific language.

say_en.text: Draft the methods section for this experiment.
say_en.note: Claude will extract details from repo artifacts.

say_en.text: Check the results for claim-evidence alignment.
say_en.note: Claude will verify each claim against evidence.
